item.title: Ten injured in Australia as car crashes into crowd north of Sydney
item.description: Ten people were injured when a man drove into a crowd in the Australian city of Newcastle on Saturday after appearing to lose control of the car, authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ten people were injured when a man drove into a crowd in the Australian city of Newcastle on Saturday after appearing to lose control of the car, authorities said. The 18-year-old driver was arrested at the scene in the suburb of Wallsend about 110 km (70 miles) north of the New South Wales state capital, Sydney. When the incident occurred, fans had lined local streets to send off the Newcastle Knights rugby league team, due to compete in the country's National Rugby League grand final in Sydney on Sunday. Two of those hospitalised, a 5-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man, were in a critical condition, authorities said. Newcastle Mayor Gavin Morris said the driver seemed to have lost control of the car. "It appears that he was revving the car in some form," Morris said in televised remarks. Police said initial indications suggested the incident was not terrorism-related.

item.title: Dominican Republic bans Haiti from its stadiums after Nations League clash
item.description: The Dominican Republic on Friday banned Haiti's national soccer team from playing at its sports venues after crowd trouble at a Concacaf Nations League match between the two island neighbours.
item.dc:creator: Paul Mathiasen
item.content:encoded: The Dominican Republic on Friday banned Haiti's national soccer team from playing at its sports venues after crowd trouble at a Concacaf Nations League match between the two island neighbours. Sports Minister Kelvin Cruz announced the ban after incidents before the match on Thursday night at the entrances to the Felix Sanchez Olympic Stadium in Santo Domingo. Video posted on social media showed groups of fans forcing some entrances, with one gate damaged. "What we saw yesterday with a gate at the Felix Sanchez, a sports facility that has cost millions and millions of pesos to make it shine, is unacceptable," Cruz said, citing a zero-tolerance policy on indiscipline. Dominican Republic President Luis Abinader backed the decision. The Haitian Football Federation did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the ban. In a post on X after the match, the federation called it a "beautiful night for Haiti, beautiful night for the island we share," adding: "On the field, competition; off the field, respect for the neighbor." Haiti won the match 4-1, with Sunderland striker Wilson Isidor scoring twice. The win gave Haiti nine points in Group A, while the Dominican Republic stayed on six. Haiti play Costa Rica in San Jose on Sunday. Isidor was filmed saying, "Hispaniola is Haiti." Hispaniola is the Caribbean island shared by the Dominican Republic and Haiti, which have long clashed over migration and border security. Dominican federation president Jose Deschamps called Isidor's remark "a lack of respect for national sovereignty" and said the federation would file a complaint with FIFA and Concacaf. The two sports governing bodies did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Haiti's embassy in Santo Domingo said the remarks, made "in the heat of competition and the intensity characteristic of sporting events", did not reflect the position of the Haitian government and thanked Dominican authorities for the event. "Sporting rivalries must not call into question relations of good neighborliness and mutual respect that must prevail between the two states," the embassy said in a statement. Haiti and the Dominican Republic have long had tense diplomatic relations. Abinader's government has stepped up deportations of undocumented Haitians since 2024, when it pledged to deport up to [USN:S0N3L1018 TEXT:"10,000 people a week"]. Sport has been drawn into the neighbours' disputes before. In 2023, after Abinader shut the border in a dispute over a Haitian canal on the shared Massacre River, Haiti's sports ministry ordered its football federation to stop staging national team matches in the Dominican Republic.

item.title: Législatives en Lettonie dans un contexte marqué par les incursions de drones et la guerre en Ukraine
item.description: Les Lettons sont appelés aux urnes samedi pour des élections législatives qui devraient voir le Premier ministre pro-ukrainien Andris Kulbergs être reconduit à son poste, même si une profonde fragmentation politique pourrait compliquer la formation d'un gouvernement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les Lettons sont appelés aux urnes samedi pour des élections législatives qui devraient voir le Premier ministre pro-ukrainien Andris Kulbergs être reconduit à son poste, même si une profonde fragmentation politique pourrait compliquer la formation d'un gouvernement. De nombreux électeurs sont sur le qui-vive en Lettonie, pays balte membre de l'Otan et de l'Union européenne, après des avertissements officiels concernant une éventuelle agression russe et le nombre croissant d'incursions dans l'espace aérien liées à la guerre en Ukraine. La Russie affirme que les accusations selon lesquelles elle prévoit d'attaquer l'Otan sont sans fondement et les responsables occidentaux estiment que Moscou n'est pas en mesure de lancer une attaque directe. Les préoccupations en matière de sécurité ont toutefois pesé lourdement dans la campagne électorale en Lettonie. Les sondages créditent la Liste unie, formation centriste de Andris Kulbergs, d'environ 14% des voix, suivie de près par le parti ouvertement pro-russe "Pouvoir souverain". Andris Kulbergs, 47 ans, est arrivé au pouvoir en mai après l'effondrement de la coalition précédente, en raison de la façon dont elle a géré des incidents au cours desquels des drones militaires avaient pénétré dans l'espace aérien letton sans être détectés. Bien que ces drones fussent ukrainiens, les responsables ont accusé la Russie de les avoir fait dévier de leur trajectoire de vol. "Nous devons fournir dès maintenant à l'Ukraine tout ce qui est nécessaire pour qu'elle puisse prendre le dessus et l'emporter", a déclaré Andris Kulbergs à Reuters le mois dernier. Tout au long de la campagne, il a également promis de renforcer les capacités anti-drones de la Lettonie et de maintenir les dépenses de défense à 5% du produit intérieur brut, l'un des niveaux les plus élevés de l'Otan. Ses rivaux pro-Kremlin affirment quant à eux que la Lettonie devrait cesser toute aide à l'Ukraine et se concentrer davantage sur les questions liées au coût de la vie, en particulier au sein de la minorité russophone de son pays. "Nos électeurs veulent la paix, ne plus avoir à chercher des abris, ne plus subir les alertes aériennes", a déclaré à Reuters la présidente de "Pouvoir Souverain", Julia Stepanenko. "La guerre ne doit en aucun cas être encouragée, y compris par son financement. L'Ukraine doit gagner, mais par le biais de négociations de paix." Les bureaux de vote ouvriront samedi à 08h00 (05h00 GMT) et fermeront à 20h00. Les premiers résultats sont attendus dans les heures qui suivent et le résultat final devrait être connu après minuit.

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース、スクバルがブレーブスとの第1戦で先発へ
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のドジャースは、３日に行われるブレーブスとのナ・リーグ地区シリーズ（ＮＬＤＳ）第１戦で左腕タリク・スクバル投手（２９）を先発起用することを決めた。

今季開幕投手を務め、昨季のプレーオフでも活躍した山本由伸投手ではなく、スクバルが第１戦を任される。スクバルは「第１戦に先発し、コーチ陣やチームメート、球団から信頼されてマウンドを託されるのは名誉であり、光栄なこと。チームを勝てる状況に持っていけるよう、自分にできることをしたい。楽しみにしている」と意気込みを示した。

ア・リーグのサイ・ヤング賞（最優秀投手賞）を２年連続で受賞しているスクバルは、８月２日にタイガースからトレードで加入。今季はタイガースで１６試合に先発して７勝５敗、防御率２．７９の数字を残し、ドジャース移籍後は１０試合で５勝２敗、防御率２．６１だった。

２０２０年にタイガースでメジャーデビューして以降、レギュラーシーズン通算では７シーズンで６６勝４４敗、防御率３．０２。タイガースで臨んだ過去２季のプレーオフでは６試合に先発して２勝１敗、防御率２．０４を記録し、チームは両年ともア・リーグ地区シリーズに進出した。

item.title: 9月雇用統計はトレンドに整合、次回会合までにさらなる情報＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２日、９月の米雇用...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
9月雇用統計はトレンドに整合、次回会合までにさらなる情報＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 10:19 配信

ニューヨーク市で2025年11月撮影　REUTERS/Brendan McDermid/File Photo

Michael S. Derby

[２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２日、９月の米雇用統計は最近の雇用情勢と整合的との認識を示した上で、今後の金融政策を決めるまでにはまだ時間があると述べた。

ハマック氏は米公共放送ＰＢＳの番組「ニュースアワー」のインタビューで、「過去１２カ月は平均で毎月４万１０００人の雇用が生まれている。これは私が推計する（雇用セクターの）ブレークイーブンとおおむね一致する」と述べ、労働市場が安定的に推移していることを示唆するとした。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策対応については、「月末の会合までに、さらに多くの情報が得られる。２つの責務を確実に果たせるよう、適切な政策スタンスを決める時間は十分にある」と語った。

ＦＲＢは先月、約３年ぶりに０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定した。ハマック氏は、早い段階から利上げを支持してきた。

今週、複数のＦＲＢ高官が、追加利上げの前にデータを見極める時間があるとの認識を示した。また９月の雇用統計発表後、１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測が後退し、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチでは据え置きの確率が８６％となっている。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：虚偽説明や失敗隠しも、中国系ＡＩエージェントにも「暴走」リスク アングル：欧米自動車メーカー、防衛需要取り込み推進　業績貢献は限定的か コラム：英バーナム首相、ＥＵ再接近に本腰　市場揺らす「ブリターン」構想 アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：米株高支える高い増益、投資家は持続可能性に不安も 最終更新: 10/3(土) 10:19 ロイター

item.title: Vietnam's quarterly GDP grows fastest in 4 years as exports boom
item.description: Vietnam’s gross domestic product grew 9.95% in the third quarter from a year earlier, the fastest quarterly growth since the COVID pandemic, and accelerating from a revised expansion of 8.81% in the second quarter, government data showed on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vietnam’s gross domestic product grew 9.95% in the third quarter from a year earlier, the fastest quarterly growth since the COVID pandemic, and accelerating from a revised expansion of 8.81% in the second quarter, government data showed on Saturday. Growth in the July-September quarter was driven by strong exports and robust investment in infrastructure, but remains short of the country’s full-year growth target of above 10%. The export-reliant economy has faced rising import costs this year due to the Iran war, with the trade deficit in the first nine months of this year hitting a record high. Exports of goods in September rose 39.1% from a year earlier to $59.48 billion, while imports were up 45.8% to $58.21 billion, resulting in a trade surplus of $1.27 billion for the month, the National Statistics Office said in a report. For the first nine months of this year, exports rose 24.5% to $434.30 billion, while imports were up 36.7% to $453.72 billion, translating into a trade deficit of $19.42 billion, a record high. Higher prices for energy imports were partly to blame for the widening trade deficit. Imports of crude oil in the period fell 13.5% in volume, but were up 14.4% in value, according to the report. Imports of refined fuels rose 11.5% in volume but were up 79.3% in value. Consumer prices in September rose 5.08% from a year earlier, the NSO said. Industrial production in September increased 16.7% year on year, it added. The data showed total investment in the nine-month period rose 16.7% from a year earlier, as the country has been ramping up public investment in infrastructure as part of its efforts to boost growth. Foreign investment inflows in the nine-month period rose 12.1% from a year earlier to $21.1 billion, the NSO said. The Asian Development Bank, which last week raised its forecast on Vietnam’s economic growth for this year to 7.8% from 7.2%, said the country's near-term growth prospects remain robust, underpinned by continued expansion in manufacturing, buoyant domestic consumption, and sustained foreign direct investment. However, for the longer term, it said “weaker global demand and heightened external uncertainty could weigh on growth, while higher energy prices and tighter global financial conditions could add to inflation and exchange-rate pressures.” Laura Schwartz, senior Asia analyst at risk intelligence company Verisk Maplecroft, said concerns are rising around Vietnam’s economy potentially running too hot, particularly given accelerating inflation in recent months. "Potential electricity shortfalls in the near- and mid-term will also pose significant challenges," she added.

item.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile toward sea, say South Korea and Japan
item.description: SEOUL: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday (Oct 3), South Korea and Japan said, its latest missile launch this ye
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

North Korea fires ballistic missile toward sea, say South Korea and Japan

FAST

SEOUL: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday (Oct 3), South Korea and Japan said, its latest missile launch this year that came a day after it rejected Seoul's accusation of its mines wounding soldiers. The missile was launched from the Wonsan area at around 6.30am on Saturday (5.30am Singapore time) and flew more than 700 kilometres, the South Korean military said in a statement. Seoul and Washington were analysing the test for details, it added. Japan's coast guard, in an emailed statement citing the Japanese defence ministry, said the object may have been a ballistic missile and appeared to have come down, warning ships to take precautions. South Korea's military said it has raised its monitoring of any further missile tests and will share intelligence with the US and Japan.

The South Korean presidential office's national security council convened an emergency meeting on Saturday to assess the situation after the missile launch, the office said in a statement. North Korea has launched missile tests on more than 10 occasions so far this year. Pyongyang has sometimes said it was testing new types of weapons systems. Some of the tests have come after North Korea protested joint military drills between Seoul and Washington. The launch came after Pyongyang's Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong Un, issued a statement on Friday that dismissed Seoul's demand for an apology for what it said were North Korean mines that seriously wounded South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarised Zone, a heavily fortified area between the two Koreas. South Korea said this week that North Korean mines caused the blast that seriously injured two South Korean soldiers on a reconnaissance mission inside the 4-km-wide border that stretches across the Korean Peninsula. The missile test may be an attempt by Pyongyang to draw a response from South Korea to the sister's statement, said Cheong Seong-chang, vice president at the Sejong Institute in Seoul, a research centre on North Korean affairs. North Korea may also have tested a new type of missile , he added. North Korea has sharply ramped up hostility against the South in recent years, disavowing unification as a national goal and calling South Korea its "primary foe".

item.title: Judge bars building of Texas-Mexico border barrier in Big Bend National Park
item.description: A federal judge on Friday barred the Trump administration from building a US-Mexico border barrier through Big Bend National Park in Texas while courts consider an environmental lawsuit challenging the project.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: A federal judge on Friday barred the Trump administration from building a US-Mexico border barrier through Big Bend National Park in Texas while courts consider an environmental lawsuit challenging the project. The ruling came nearly seven weeks after US Customs and Border Protection Commissioner Rodney Scott [USN:L6N44E0WK TEXT:"paused construction"] amid bipartisan criticism of the border project and its potential impact on the park's landscape and wildlife. Customs and Border Protection has said it planned to build roads, surveillance technology and vehicle barriers in the national park, rather than the 30-foot-high (9-meter-high) walls in other border areas. Crews started clearing land in the park in August, prompting protests and lawsuits seeking to halt the work. Scott said he wanted to put the project on hold until he could visit the area, "do a personal evaluation" and speak with some of the interested parties. The preliminary injunction issued by US District Judge Kathleen Cardone effectively prevents Scott from changing his mind. It says the government "shall not build border barrier or related infrastructure, or engage in any construction of ground-disturbing activities, in the Big Bend Sector," unless it complies with environmental laws. The lawsuit was brought by the Center for Biological Diversity, a group called Friends of the Ruidosa Church and a Big Bend-area river guide and landowner. Cardone ruled that the plaintiffs were likely to prevail on at least some of their claims once the lawsuit is fully considered, and would face serious, irreparable harm without an injunction. The plaintiffs asserted that the Trump administration, including Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, had improperly granted a sweeping waiver of environmental statutes to fast-track the Big Bend border plan. President Donald Trump, a Republican, has long touted building or reinforcing barriers along the southern US border to deter illegal immigration. But his administration's push to extend border infrastructure into Big Bend, around 250 miles (400 km) southeast of El Paso, faced opposition from local officials, conservationists and some Texas Republicans. US Senator John Cornyn, a Texas Republican, has urged Homeland Security officials to consult with local leaders and reconsider proposed barriers in Big Bend, arguing that the area's rugged terrain already provides a natural deterrent.

item.title: サッカー＝フランスはイタリアと引き分け、ジダン監督のホーム初陣
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）は２日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、リーグＡの１組ではフランスがホームでイタリアに１─１で引き分けた。

フランスは０─０で迎えた後半１０分、ゴール右寄りの位置でＦＫを得ると、少し動かしたボールをミカエル・オリーズが左足でシュートし、ネットを揺らした。しかし、同２３分に自陣でのボールロストからアレッサンドロ・バストーニに同点弾を許すと、同４０分にはダヨ・ウパメカノが２枚目のイエローカードを受けて退場した。

フランス指揮官就任後のホーム初戦をドローで終えたジネディーヌ・ジダン監督は、ＴＦ１で「選手たちのことを思うと非常に残念だ。われわれはもっと良い結果に値するプレーを見せていた。選手たちを誇りに思う。ハードワークやプレッシングは、まさに模範的だった」と振り返った。

同組のもう１試合では、ベルギーがホームでトルコと対戦。ケビン・デブルイネの２得点とロメル・ルカクのゴールにより、３─０で快勝した。

この結果、１組は３試合を終えて勝ち点７のフランスが首位。ベルギーは勝ち点６の２位で、イタリアは勝ち点４の３位。勝ち点０のトルコは最下位となっている。

item.title: Ｆ１＝バーレーンＧＰフリー走行、フェルスタッペンが最速
item.description: ［セパン（マレーシア） ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［セパン（マレーシア）　２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のバーレーン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２日、マレーシアのセパンでフリー走行を行い、レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

中東情勢を受けてマレーシアで開催されている今大会、フェルスタッペンはフリー走行１回目に１分３７秒５２０をマークした。２回目でトップだったフェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が１分３７秒５２８で続き、その差はわずか０秒００８だった。

３番手は２回目に１分３７秒６２７を記録したレッドブルのアイザック・ハジャー（フランス）。昨季王者でマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）が２回目に１分３７秒６６５で４番手だった。

個人総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス、イタリア）は２回目の１分３８秒０６０が自己ベストで８番手だった。

item.title: サッカー＝久保建英選手が結婚、俳優の福原遥さんと
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部、レアル・ソシエダードに所属する日本代表ＭＦ久保建英選手が、俳優の福原遥さんと結婚したことを発表した。

両者は２日、それぞれのインスタグラムでツーショットの写真を披露し、「久保建英と福原遥は結婚致しましたことをご報告させていただきます。お互い、幼い頃からたくさんの方の支えがあって今があります。まだまだ未熟な私たちですが、皆様への感謝の気持ちを忘れることなく、共に助け合い、笑顔あふれる温かい家庭を築いていきたいと思っております」とコメントした。

２００１年生まれの久保選手は１１年にスペインの名門バルセロナの下部組織に加入。その後、ＦＣ東京で下部組織を経てトップチームデビューを飾るなどし、１９年にバルセロナの宿敵であるレアル・マドリードに移籍した。

スペインではマジョルカ、ビリャレアル、ヘタフェでもプレーした後、２２年に現在も所属するソシエダードに移籍。日本代表では１９年に１８歳でデビューを飾り、２２年と２６年のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）に出場している。

item.title: Ataque israelense mata quatro pessoas em Gaza, dizem equipes médicas
item.description: Um ataque aéreo israelense matou pelo menos quatro palestinos em um prédio de apartamentos na Cidade de Gaza na madrugada de sábado (horário local), informaram autoridades de saúde do território.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um ataque aéreo israelense matou pelo menos quatro palestinos em um prédio de apartamentos na Cidade de Gaza na madrugada de sábado (horário local), informaram autoridades de saúde do território. Não houve comentário imediato por parte das Forças Armadas israelenses. Os EUA mediaram um cessar-fogo no território no ano passado, mas os negociadores ainda não chegaram a um acordo sobre os termos para o desarmamento do Hamas e a retirada das tropas israelenses. Israel, que afirma que o Hamas vem se rearmando e lançando ataques em violação ao cessar-fogo de outubro, intensificou os ataques contra o grupo nas últimas semanas. O Hamas negou estar tentando realizar ataques ou reconstruir seu arsenal e acusa Israel de minar o acordo de paz de Gaza. Autoridades de saúde de Gaza afirmaram que pelo menos 1.400 palestinos foram mortos por disparos israelenses desde o cessar-fogo de outubro passado. Israel afirma que quatro de seus soldados foram mortos por militantes em Gaza no mesmo período.

item.title: Latvians vote in election in shadow of drone incursions and war in Ukraine
item.description: Latvians vote in a parliamentary election on Saturday that is likely to keep power in the hands of pro-Ukrainian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, although deep political fragmentation may complicate the formation of a government.
item.dc:creator: Andrius Sytas
item.content:encoded: Latvians vote in a parliamentary election on Saturday that is likely to keep power in the hands of pro-Ukrainian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, although deep political fragmentation may complicate the formation of a government. Across the Baltics, including in NATO and European Union member Latvia, many voters are on edge after official warnings of potential Russia aggression and a growing number of airspace incursions related to Moscow's war in Ukraine. Russia says accusations that it is planning to attack NATO are baseless and Western officials say it is not capable of launching a direct assault, but security concerns have weighed heavily in the election campaign. [USN:L8N45L1R2 TEXT:"Opinion polls"] put Kulbergs' centrist United List ahead, with about 14% of votes, but followed closely by the overtly pro-Russian Sovereign Power. A businessman and amateur rally driver, Kulbergs, 47, came to power in May after the previous coalition crumbled over its handling of incidents in which [USN:L1N41K03T TEXT:"stray military drones flew"] undetected into Latvia. Though the drones were Ukrainian, officials [USN:L8N41X1AC TEXT:"have blamed Russia"] for causing them to divert from their flight paths. "We have to give Ukraine everything necessary right now (so) that they can have the upper hand and win", Kulbergs told Reuters in an interview last month. Throughout his campaign, he has also promised more anti-drone capabilities for Latvia and to maintain defence spending at 5% of gross domestic product, one of the highest levels in NATO. But his pro-Kremlin rivals say Latvia should stop any aid to Ukraine and should instead focus more on cost-of-living issues, particularly among his country's Russian-speaking minority. "Our voters want peace, to stop looking for shelters, to no longer experience the air alerts", party leader Julia Stepanenko told Reuters. "The war must not be encouraged in any way, including by financing it... Ukraine must win, but through peace talks". Polls open at 8 a.m. (0500 GMT) on Saturday and close at 8 p.m., with the first results expected within hours and the final result likely to be clear after midnight. The 100 members of the Saeima, or parliament, are being elected for a four-year term. DIVIDED NATION Surveys show at least two other parties may make it into parliament - the populist, MAGA-style Latvia First grouping and the Progressives, a left-leaning party that attracts younger voters. Kulbergs' ability to forge a working coalition will depend largely on how many votes they receive and how many other parties cross the 5% threshhold to enter parliament. He might also need to cobble together a deal with Latvia First leader, businessman Ainars Slesers, who appears to have shifted towards a more anti-Ukraine stance in recent months, courting votes on both sides. "His message is that (the party) condemns Russia's invasion and stands with Ukraine, but that supporting Ukraine comes at the expense of Latvia's economy," said Roberts Kits, researcher for the Latvian Strategy and Economic Research Institute, in a note. Latvia, with a population of 1.9 million, is sandwiched between the Baltic Sea, with EU and NATO allies Estonia and Lithuania to the north and south, and Russia and Belarus to the east.

item.title: アジア大会＝サッカー日本女子代表、北朝鮮下し3連覇
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会は２日、サッカー女子決勝を行い、日本が北朝鮮との２─２からのＰＫ戦を５─３で制し、３大会連続最多４度目の優勝を果たした。

日本は前半３２分に上野真実が右足の鋭いシュートをゴール左に決めて先制。しかし、後半２分に追いつかれると、同２４分には逆転を許した。

それでも、同４１分に途中出場の西尾葉音が同点弾をマークし、延長戦へ。ＰＫ戦までもつれ込むと、北朝鮮の３人目のシュートをＧＫ大場朱羽がセーブ。日本は５人全員がＰＫを成功させた。

item.title: Hammack, do Fed, diz à PBS que ainda há tempo para avaliar próximo passo na política monetária
item.description: A presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o relatório de emprego dos EUA de setembro está em linha com a tendência recente de contratações, observando que ela ainda tem tempo antes de precisar tomar uma decisão sobre os próximos passos da política monetária.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: A presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o relatório de emprego dos EUA de setembro está em linha com a tendência recente de contratações, observando que ela ainda tem tempo antes de precisar tomar uma decisão sobre os próximos passos da política monetária. O relatório de empregos de setembro, que mostrou um aumento aparentemente fraco de 29 mil novos empregos e uma alta na taxa de desemprego para 4,2%, está em linha com o desempenho recente do setor, disse Hammack em entrevista ao programa PBS News Hour. “Em média, o que observamos nos últimos 12 meses foi a criação de 41.000 novos empregos por mês. Isso está amplamente alinhado com minha estimativa do ponto de equilíbrio” para o setor, o que, por sua vez, sugere uma tendência de estabilidade no mercado de trabalho, disse Hammack. Quanto à forma como o Fed deveria reagir com a política monetária, Hammack disse: “Ainda teremos muitas informações antes de nossa reunião no final do mês e, portanto, há muito tempo para tomar uma decisão sobre qual é a postura correta da política para garantir que estejamos cumprindo ambos os aspectos de nosso mandato.” Hammack tem sido uma defensora firme e precoce do aumento das taxas para reduzir as pressões inflacionárias que ela e seus pares do banco central consideram excessivas. Nesta semana, várias autoridades importantes do Fed afirmaram que o Fed tem tempo para avaliar os dados antes de aumentar as taxas novamente. No mês passado, o Fed elevou sua meta de taxa de juros em um quarto de ponto percentual, para uma faixa entre 3,75% e 4%, enquanto as autoridades sinalizavam a expectativa de outro aumento antes do final do ano. Os comentários das autoridades nesta semana indicaram que não é provável que haja qualquer ação sobre as taxas na reunião do Comitê Federal de Mercado Aberto (Fomc) marcada para 27 e 28 de outubro.

item.title: Israeli strike kills five in Gaza, health officials say
item.description: An Israeli airstrike killed at least five Palestinians in an apartment building in Gaza City early on Saturday, health and civil defense service officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Israeli airstrike killed at least five Palestinians in an apartment building in Gaza City early on Saturday, health and civil defense service officials said. There was no immediate comment from the Israeli military. The US brokered a ceasefire in the territory last year but negotiators have not agreed on terms for Hamas to disarm and for Israel to withdraw its troops. Israel, which says Hamas has been rearming and launching attacks in violation of an October ceasefire, has stepped up strikes on the group in recent weeks. Hamas has denied trying to carry out attacks or rebuild its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the Gaza peace deal. Gaza health officials have said at least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli fire since last October's ceasefire. Israel says four of its soldiers have been killed by militants in Gaza over the same period.

item.title: Alguns países do G20 rejeitam posição dos EUA sobre excesso de capacidade industrial
item.description: Um “punhado” de ministros do Comércio do G20 rejeitou os apelos dos EUA para conter o excesso de capacidade industrial e as políticas não orientadas pelo mercado, informou nesta sexta-feira o gabinete do Representante de Comércio dos EUA (USTR), revelando divisões dentro do grupo das principais economias do mundo.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: Um “punhado” de ministros do Comércio do G20 rejeitou os apelos dos EUA para conter o excesso de capacidade industrial e as políticas não orientadas pelo mercado, informou nesta sexta-feira o gabinete do Representante de Comércio dos EUA (USTR), revelando divisões dentro do grupo das principais economias do mundo. A declaração da presidência norte-americana do G20, divulgada um dia após o encerramento de uma reunião sobre comércio em Milwaukee, também revelou que apenas dois países — México e Argentina — aderiram a uma declaração liderada pelos EUA que pede mais esforços e cooperação para eliminar das cadeias de abastecimento produtos fabricados com trabalho forçado. A rejeição ocorre após a imposição, pelo governo Trump, de tarifas de 10% ou 12,5% sobre produtos provenientes de 59 países e da União Europeia, sob a alegação de que eles não aplicam adequadamente as proibições ao trabalho forçado. A declaração do USTR não citou os países que se opuseram à declaração sobre o excesso de capacidade. Mas a China já havia se oposto a uma declaração semelhante do G20 que denunciava o trabalho forçado e políticas econômicas não orientadas pelo mercado que levam a exportações excessivas, em uma reunião de líderes financeiros realizada há um mês em Asheville, na Carolina do Norte. “O rascunho da declaração ministerial foi apoiado por todos, exceto por um punhado de membros, alguns dos quais rejeitaram firmemente a criação desse caminho para uma ação cooperativa” sobre o excesso de capacidade, afirmou o comunicado, acrescentando que isso “decepcionou profundamente” a presidência dos EUA no G20. O excesso de capacidade industrial da China e os subsídios industriais têm sido temas centrais das reuniões ministeriais do G20 lideradas pelos EUA neste ano. Pequim rejeitou as alegações de que suas políticas industriais tenham criado excesso de capacidade e acusa os países ocidentais de usar a questão para justificar medidas protecionistas. Os EUA afirmaram que os ministros do Comércio do G20 conseguiram chegar a um consenso ao condenar a instrumentalização do comércio de alimentos, com os membros concordando “que o comércio de alimentos e produtos agrícolas não deve ser usado como ferramenta de coerção econômica ou política”.

item.title: Defesa Civil da Arábia Saudita afirma que estilhaços de míssil balístico interceptado em Asir feriram uma pessoa
item.description: A Defesa Civil Saudita informou no sábado (horário local) que estilhaços de um míssil balístico interceptado na província de Ahad Rafidah, na região de Asir, feriram uma pessoa, noticiou a agência de notícias estatal saudita.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Defesa Civil Saudita informou no sábado (horário local) que estilhaços de um míssil balístico interceptado na província de Ahad Rafidah, na região de Asir, feriram uma pessoa, noticiou a agência de notícias estatal saudita. O míssil foi lançado pelo grupo houthi do Iêmen, aliado ao Irã, informou a agência.

item.title: Crude oil tanker struck by unknown projectile off Oman, UKMTO says
item.description: The master of a crude oil tanker has reported being struck by an unknown projectile 4 nautical miles east of Oman, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said early on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The master of a crude oil tanker has reported being struck by an unknown projectile 4 nautical miles east of Oman, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said early on Saturday. UKMTO said all crew were reported safe and no environmental impact was currently reported.

item.title: Fed's Hammack tells PBS there's still time to weigh next monetary policy move
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that the September US employment report fits with the recent trend of hiring, noting she has time before she has to make a decision on what is next for monetary policy.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that the September US employment report fits with the recent trend of hiring, noting she has time before she has to make a decision on what is next for monetary policy. The September jobs report, which showed a [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"seemingly weak"] 29,000 hiring gain and a move up in the unemployment rate to 4.2%, fits in with the recent performance of the sector, Hammack said in an interview with the PBS News Hour program. “On average, what we've seen over the past 12 months is 41,000 new jobs being created each month. That's largely in line with my estimate of what the break-even is” for the sector, which in turn suggests a trend of stability for the hiring sector, Hammack said. Regarding how the Fed should react with monetary policy, Hammack said, “We'll still have a lot of information before our meeting at the end of the month, and so there's a lot of time to make a decision about what the right stance of policy is to make sure we're delivering on both sides of our mandate.” Hammack has been a steadfast and early supporter of raising rates to lower inflation pressures that she and her central bank colleagues consider too high. This week, a number of key Fed officials said the Fed [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"has time"] to weigh the data before raising rates again. The Fed last month hiked its interest rate target by a quarter percentage point, to between 3.75% and 4%, as officials penciled in expectations of another increase before year-end. The [USN:SPN45L011 TEXT:"comments"] from officials this week indicated no rate action is likely at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting scheduled for Oct. 27-28.

item.title: Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike on ventilator, attorneys say
item.description: The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings that pre-existing medical conditions would make placing IV lines especially difficult.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike on ventilator, attorneys say

The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings that pre-existing medical conditions would make placing IV lines especially difficult.

A picture taken on Dec 4, 2007, shows death-row inmate Christa Pike entering the Knox County Criminal Court in Knoxville, Tennessee, US, obtained by Reuters on Sep 30, 2026. (File photo: J. Miles Cary/ Knoxville News Sentinel/USA Today Network via Reuters)

NASHVILLE: Convicted killer Christa Pike was left gravely ill, unconscious and hospitalised on life support after Tennessee's failed attempt to execute her by lethal injection, her lawyers said on Friday (Oct 2), providing the first detailed account of the injuries she suffered. Hospital staff were working to save Pike's life and clear the drug pentobarbital from her system, her attorneys said in an emergency motion, which seeks a court order for Tennessee's Department of Correction to preserve evidence from Wednesday night's botched execution. Pike remained in critical condition, intubated and hooked to a mechanical ventilator to breathe, her lawyers said, after two doses of pentobarbital were administered to her intravenously at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville, the state capital. The bungled attempt to establish intravenous lines also left both her arms "swollen, burned and blistered", the apparent result of the pentobarbital, a highly alkaline and caustic substance, seeping into the tissues under her skin, the court filing said. 'VEINS HAD BLOWN'

The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings from Pike's doctors that pre-existing medical conditions — small veins and a blood disorder called thrombocytosis — would make placing IV lines especially difficult. "At no point did any member of the execution team realise that the IV lines were not correctly placed or that the veins had blown and that the pentobarbital was, in whole or in part, entering Ms. Pike's body," her lawyers said in a filing in the Chancery Court for Tennessee's 20th Judicial District. It said witnesses to the execution attempt could hear Pike "crying, whimpering and breathing loudly throughout the procedure". The filing provided the fullest picture yet of the medical consequences of an attempted execution that Tennessee Governor Bill Lee said followed the state's established protocol. It was the state's second botched execution this year, prompting Lee to halt any further attempts to carry out the death penalty for the rest of 2026. He also ordered an independent review of what went wrong.

Related:

Tennessee death row inmate in hospital after surviving two lethal injections

Pike, 50, was convicted three decades ago of first-degree murder for her role in the torture and killing of a 19-year-old vocational school classmate, Colleen Slemmer, at the University of Tennessee campus in Knoxville in 1995, when Pike was 18. She had been scheduled to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than two centuries, and the only person in the modern era of US capital punishment to be executed in that state for a crime committed by a teenager. Pike's then-17-year-old boyfriend was tried as an adult and convicted of murder as well, but received a life sentence with eligibility for parole. A third schoolmate who was 18 at the time and acted as a lookout for the two others ended up testifying for the prosecution and received probation. Lee earlier this week rejected a clemency petition seeking to commute Pike's death penalty to a life prison term without the possibility of parole. The petition argued for leniency, in part, on the basis of her childhood history of severe neglect, sexual abuse that included two rapes, and untreated mental illness. The clemency petition also cited evidence that Pike's mother drank heavily during pregnancy, contributing to faulty brain development that made it difficult for her to control her impulses. The US Supreme Court on Wednesday lifted an 11th-hour stay of execution, which was issued earlier in the day by a federal appeals court to give more time to weigh Pike's claim that her childhood trauma was not properly considered in her sentencing. In their filing on Friday, Pike's lawyers urged the state Chancery Court to order preservation of evidence they said would show that state prison personnel violated her constitutional rights by subjecting her to cruel and unusual punishment.

Source: Reuters/bg

item.title: 'Handful' of G20 countries reject US stance on excess industrial capacity
item.description: A "handful" of Group of 20 trade ministers rejected US calls to curb excess industrial capacity and "non-market" policies, the US Trade Representative's office said on Friday, exposing divisions within the group of major economies.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: A "handful" of Group of 20 trade ministers rejected US calls to curb excess industrial capacity and "non-market" policies, the US Trade Representative's office said on Friday, exposing divisions within the group of major economies. The US, this year's G20 chair, issued the statement a day after a [USN:L1N45N131 TEXT:"trade meeting in Milwaukee"] that revealed that only two countries — Mexico and Argentina — signed on to a US-led statement calling for more work and cooperation to eliminate mgoods produced with forced labor from supply chains. The rejection from the vast majority of G20 countries follows the Trump administration's imposition of tariffs of 10% or 12.5% on goods from 59 countries and the European Union over allegations that they fail to adequately enforce bans on forced labor. USTR also is conducting a second "Section 301" tariff investigation into 16 trading partners that show signs of excess industrial capacity. The probe is widely expected to lead to new duties in coming months. The USTR statement did not name countries that objected to the excess-capacity statement. But China had [USN:L1N44T0JC TEXT:"objected"] to a similar G20 statement denouncing forced labor and non-market economic policies that lead to excessive exports at a finance leaders' meeting a month ago in North Carolina. "The draft ministerial statement was supported by all but a handful of members, a few of whom firmly rejected creating this pathway toward cooperative action" on excess capacity, the statement said, adding that this "severely disappointed" the US G20 presidency. China's excess industrial capacity and industrial subsidies have been key themes of the US-led G20 ministerial meetings so far this year. Beijing has rejected claims that its industrial policies have created excess capacity, accusing Western countries of using the issue to justify protectionist measures. The US said that G20 trade ministers reached consensus on denouncing the weaponization of food trade, with members agreeing that trade in food or agricultural inputs should not be used as a tool for economic or political coercion. In that G20 joint statement, the ministers defined the weaponization of food as measures to "slow, stop, block or direct the flow of food and agricultural inputs" to exert coercive pressure to extract unrelated geopolitical concessions. "We condemn food weaponization, as it poses a significant humanitarian and economic threat," the G20 trade ministers said. After pressure from US President Donald Trump that included the threat of a US diesel export ban, Group of Seven countries on Friday [USN:B5N44301Y TEXT:"agreed to release"] some 100 million barrels of diesel reserves to try to drive down record-high US diesel prices. The fuel is widely used in agricultural production. TARIFF STRUCTURE DISCUSSIONS US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Thursday that he did not seek a joint statement on a fourth discussion topic, reforming the "most favored nation" system of published, unconditional global tariff rates that underpin the World Trade Organization. MFN tariffs have defined the global trading system since the end of World War Two. Greer has argued that the MFN principle has been abused by non-market-oriented economies such as China that have subsidized industries, but it does not allow these countries to be treated differently. The US statement said some G20 members had expressed a willingness to consider changes to MFN, including expanding exceptions to the principle and issuing new legal interpretations to enable greater use of existing exceptions.

item.title: Tribunal de apelações dos EUA bloqueia lei de Minnesota contra fotos com nudez simulada por IA em processo da xAI
item.description: A xAI de Elon Musk conseguiu nesta sexta-feira que um tribunal federal de apelações dos EUA suspendesse a proibição do Estado de Minnesota — a primeira do país — relativa a imagens falsas de nudez geradas por IA, enquanto a empresa de tecnologia e mídias sociais dá andamento a uma ação judicial alegando que a lei é inconstitucional.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A xAI de Elon Musk conseguiu nesta sexta-feira que um tribunal federal de apelações dos EUA suspendesse a proibição do Estado de Minnesota — a primeira do país — relativa a imagens falsas de nudez geradas por IA, enquanto a empresa de tecnologia e mídias sociais dá andamento a uma ação judicial alegando que a lei é inconstitucional. O Tribunal Federal de Apelações do 8º Circuito com sede em St. Louis, em sua decisão, suspendeu a lei por enquanto, deferindo um pedido de liminar apresentado pela xAI. No mês passado, um juiz de primeira instância havia rejeitado o pedido de Musk para uma ordem que suspendesse a lei. A lei estadual contra a “nudificação”, que entrou em vigor em 1º de agosto, proíbe operadores de sites, desenvolvedores de software e outros de permitir que usuários criem imagens realistas retratando uma parte íntima do corpo que não apareça na foto original de um indivíduo identificável. A xAI alega que a medida restringe a liberdade de expressão protegida pela Constituição dos EUA. Minnesota e a xAI não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário. O juiz federal Donovan Frank decidiu no mês passado que a xAI não havia demonstrado que sofreria dano irreparável ao contestar a lei e afirmou que a empresa havia esperado tempo demais para solicitar uma medida cautelar. Em seu recurso, a xAI contestou a conclusão do juiz de que ela teria demorado a entrar com a ação. A empresa também afirmou que sua ferramenta Grok Imagine inclui “proteções rigorosas” contra a criação de imagens de nudez ou sexualizadas de pessoas reais. A xAI começou a processar usuários que, segundo ela, estão contornando os bloqueadores tecnológicos do Grok para criar imagens de caráter sexual de pessoas sem o consentimento delas. O Estado de Minnesota havia instado o tribunal de apelação a não bloquear a lei. O Estado afirmou ter adotado a medida este ano para combater a disseminação do que chamou de “uma quantidade impressionante de material de abuso sexual infantil gerado por produtos de IA como o Grok Imagine”.

item.title: Texans' Nico Collins set to return; Joey Porter Jr. may go for Cowboys
item.description: Houston Texans standout receiver Nico Collins was a full practice participant on Friday and is set to play in Sunday's home game against the Dallas Cowboys.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Houston Texans standout receiver Nico Collins was a full practice participant on Friday and is set to play in Sunday's home game against the Dallas Cowboys. Collins missed the past two games after hurting his hamstring in practice on Sept. 16. He was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday this week. A two-time Pro Bowl selection, Collins had seven catches for 75 yards and a touchdown in Houston's 36-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills in its season opener on Sept. 13. Collins, 27, has topped 1,000 receiving yards in each of the past three seasons. He had a career-best 1,297 yards in 2023. The 2021 third-round draft pick has 296 receptions for 4,422 yards and 25 scores in 67 career games (53 starts), all with the Texans. As expected, linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was ruled out for Houston (0-3). Safety M.J. Stewart (knee) didn't practice Friday and also will miss the contest. Defensive ends Jadeveon Clowney (knee) and Logan Hall (knee), guard Ed Ingram (groin) and linebacker Jake Hansen (calf) are all questionable for the Texans. Houston placed running back British Brooks (hamstring) on injured reserve Friday. For Dallas (1-2), cornerback Cobie Durant and linebacker DeMarvion Overshown were both ruled out with hamstring injuries. Safety Malik Hooker (forearm) practiced in full Friday and doesn't have an injury designation after missing the previous two games. The Cowboys are also preparing cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to play Sunday. Dallas acquired him from the Pittsburgh Steelers in a trade on Wednesday. "I think we've got a really good plan that if he does play, where we'll use him and what that will look like," Dallas coach Brian Schottenheimer told reporters on Friday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Apple says it will flag AI requests for Mac data after Meta's Muse draws complaints
item.description: Apple said on Friday that it plans to change its Mac operating system to make it more obvious when AI agents ask to access all of the data on Macs.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: Apple (AAPL.O) said on Friday that it plans to change its Mac operating system to make it more obvious when AI agents ask to access all of the data on Macs. Some users have criticized Meta's (META.O) Muse, an AI agent capable of carrying out complex tasks like canceling unused subscriptions or haggling for better prices. These people claimed the agent accessed what users believed to be private messages. On Apple's iPhones and iPads, no single app can access data inside another app by default, a technique called sandboxing. But Apple's Macs are more flexible, with a "Full Disk Access" option that allows apps such as cloud backup services to access all the data on a machine, with a user's permission. Apple on Friday said some developers were using the Full Disk Access feature in ways that could put users at risk. "Going forward, we will introduce additional controls to ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action," Apple wrote in a post . "As AI agents become increasingly capable and autonomous, the risks associated with this level of access will grow substantially. We are committed to ensuring users clearly understand these risks before granting such access, so they can make informed decisions about their own data and privacy." Apple's move comes after Inc magazine technology columnist Jason Aten accused Meta's Muse of reading private messages on his Mac. He said he had not enabled Full Disk Access. Meta spokesperson Andy Stone pushed back against those claims last week, saying Muse's access to Apple's Messages app is strictly opt-in. "You have to enable both Full Disk Access and the Messages connector for Muse to be able to read your Messages content," Stone wrote on social media platform X . "It can't read your Messages unless you do this. And it can be revoked at any time." Apple declined to comment beyond its post. Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Kirkland, Latham top M&A adviser rankings amid 3rd quarter slowdown
item.description: Law firm Kirkland & Ellis was the lead global M&A legal adviser by deal value in the first nine months of 2026, and Latham & Watkins advised on more deals than any other firm, according to new data released Friday by LSEG.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: Law firm Kirkland & Ellis was the lead global M&A legal adviser by deal value in the first nine months of 2026, and Latham & Watkins advised on more deals than any other firm, according to new data released Friday by LSEG. M&A deals announced in the first three quarters reached $3.9 trillion, a 28% increase compared to the same period last year and the "strongest opening period for deal making since 2021," LSEG said in its M&A legal adviser rankings. But aggregate deal value took a nosedive in the third quarter, dropping 41% compared to the second quarter of 2026, LSEG found. In the first three quarters combined, Kirkland worked on 565 deals worth $601 billion, followed by Sullivan & Cromwell with 159 deals worth $473 billion, according to LSEG's rankings of advisers on announced transactions by deal value. Latham was top-ranked by number of deals, handling 613 deals worth an overall $457 billion. Goodwin was second, advising on 587 deals worth $232 billion. Last quarter was the first time since the second quarter of 2025 that quarterly deal value dropped below $1 trillion, LSEG found. The number of mega deals -- transactions worth more than $10 billion -- and the total number of deals [USN:L6N45M0VD TEXT:"both dropped in the third quarter"]. "I don't view it as that surprising we're seeing volatility, that's been the theme the last few years," said Josh Zachariah, who leads Goodwin Procter's M&A group. Dealmakers faced headwinds in the last quarter that included stock market volatility, rising oil prices and "stubborn" inflation, Zachariah said. Paul Kukish, who serves as global co-chair of Latham's M&A and private equity practice, said in a statement he expects to see "some continued caution, especially for larger, more transformational deals, but not a uniform pause across the market" in the fourth quarter of 2026. Kukish and Zachariah both said their firms are busy with M&A work. Spokespersons for Kirkland and Sullivan & Cromwell had no immediate comment.

item.title: Coreia do Norte dispara projétil não identificado em direção ao mar na costa leste, diz governo sul-coreano
item.description: Coreia do Norte disparou um projétil não identificado em direção ao mar, na costa leste do país, informou o Estado-Maior Conjunto da Coreia do Sul em um comunicado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Coreia do Norte disparou um projétil não identificado em direção ao mar, na costa leste do país, informou o Estado-Maior Conjunto da Coreia do Sul em um comunicado. O lançamento ocorreu depois que Kim Yo Jong, de Pyongyang — irmã influente do líder Kim Jong Un —, divulgou nesta sexta-feira um comunicado rejeitando a exigência de Seul de um pedido de desculpas pelas minas norte-coreanas que feriram gravemente soldados sul-coreanos na Zona Desmilitarizada, uma área fortemente fortificada entre as duas Coreias. A Coreia do Sul afirmou nesta semana que as minas norte-coreanas causaram a explosão que feriu gravemente dois soldados sul-coreanos durante uma missão de reconhecimento dentro da fronteira de 4 km de largura que se estende pela Península Coreana. A Coreia do Norte intensificou drasticamente sua hostilidade contra o Sul nos últimos anos, renegando a unificação como objetivo nacional e chamando a Coreia do Sul de seu “principal inimigo”.

item.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile toward sea, South Korea and Japan say
item.description: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said, its latest missile launch this year that came a day after it rejected Seoul's accusation of its mines wounding soldiers.
item.dc:creator: Heejin Kim
item.content:encoded: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said, its latest missile launch this year that came a day after it rejected Seoul's accusation of its mines wounding soldiers. The missile was launched from the Wonsan area at around 6.30 a.m. on Saturday (2130 GMT, Friday) and flew more than 700 kilometres (434 miles), the South Korean military said in a statement. Seoul and Washington were analysing the test for details, it added. Japan's coast guard, in an emailed statement citing the Japanese defence ministry, said the object may have been a ballistic missile and appeared to have come down, warning ships to take precautions. South Korea's military said it has raised its monitoring of any further missile tests and will share intelligence with the US and Japan . The South Korean presidential office's national security council convened an emergency meeting on Saturday to assess the situation after the missile launch, the office said in a statement. North Korea has launched missile tests on more than 10 occasions so far this year. Pyongyang has sometimes said it was testing new types of weapons systems. Some of the tests have come after North Korea protested joint military drills between Seoul and Washington. The launch came after Pyongyang's Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong Un, issued a [USN:L1N45O07Z TEXT:"statement"] on Friday that dismissed Seoul's demand for an apology for what it said were North Korean mines that seriously wounded South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarised Zone, a heavily fortified area between the two Koreas. South Korea said this week that North Korean mines caused the blast that seriously injured two South Korean soldiers on a reconnaissance mission inside the 4-km-wide (2.5-mile) border that stretches across the Korean Peninsula. The missile test may be an attempt by Pyongyang to draw a response from South Korea to the sister's statement, said Cheong Seong-chang, vice president at the Sejong Institute in Seoul, a research centre on North Korean affairs. North Korea may also have tested a new type of missile, he added. North Korea has sharply ramped up hostility against the South in recent years, disavowing unification as a national goal and calling South Korea its "primary foe".

item.title: Colombia canjea deuda interna por 19,8 billones de pesos
item.description: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que canjeó títulos de deuda pública interna por 19,8 billones de pesos (5.985 millones de dólares), en busca de disminuir la presión de pagos previstos para este y el próximo año.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que canjeó títulos de deuda pública interna por 19,8 billones de pesos (5.985 millones de dólares), en busca de disminuir la presión de pagos previstos para este y el próximo año. Se trata del primero de tres canjes de deuda pública local que el Gobierno planea realizar antes de finalizar el año. En la operación, el Ministerio de Hacienda recogió títulos de deuda pública interna TES con vencimiento entre 2026 y 2027, a cambio de los cuales entregó papeles con plazo entre 2027 y 2062, precisó el comunicado. Los TES son la segunda fuente de financiación interna del gasto público, después del recaudo de impuestos. El intercambio permitió reducir las amortizaciones en 2,4 billones de pesos este año y en 17,4 billones en 2027. "Esta operación busca gestionar proactivamente el riesgo de refinanciamiento, optimizar el manejo de la liquidez y dejar al país mejor posicionado para enfrentar los retos en materia fiscal y presupuestal en 2027", dijo el ministro de Hacienda, Miguel Gómez, citado en el comunicado. Con la operación, la vida media de la deuda interna representada en TES se incrementó en 0,2 años, al pasar de 9,97 a 10,17 años. El Gobierno anunció en agosto cambios en el presupuesto de gastos para este y el próximo año que mostraron un escenario peor de lo esperado por el mercado, en el que se elevó la proyección de déficit fiscal para este año a un 7,2% del PIB desde una previa de 5,3% y para 2027 se disparó hasta 9,4% del PIB frente a una de 4,5% esperada anteriormente. Según las nuevas cifras, el Gobierno aumentará su endeudamiento en 35 billones de pesos (10.581 millones de dólares) este año. "Invitamos a todos inversionistas a ser parte de la segunda ventana de intercambio que tendrá lugar el próximo 22 de octubre de 2026 y de la tercera ventana el próximo 19 de noviembre de 2026", afirmó Gómez. (1 dólar = 3.307,73 pesos)

item.title: Christa Pike, sobrevivente de execução no Tennessee, respira por aparelho, dizem advogados
item.description: A assassina condenada Christa Pike está inconsciente, intubada e recebendo assistência respiratória por meio de um aparelho após a tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta sexta-feira, fornecendo o primeiro relato detalhado da gravidade de seu estado após a injeção letal.
item.dc:creator: Maria Cardona
item.content:encoded: A assassina condenada Christa Pike está inconsciente, intubada e recebendo assistência respiratória por meio de um aparelho após a tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta sexta-feira, fornecendo o primeiro relato detalhado da gravidade de seu estado após a injeção letal. A equipe do hospital trabalha para salvar a vida de Pike e eliminar o pentobarbital, a droga letal, de seu organismo, afirmaram seus advogados em um pedido judicial de emergência solicitando uma ordem que exija que o Departamento Penitenciário do Tennessee preserve as provas da execução malsucedida da noite de quarta-feira. Pike continua em estado crítico, disseram seus advogados, dois dias após o Tennessee administrar duas doses de pentobarbital, sem conseguir matá-la. Ela sofreu lesões significativas nos dois braços, acrescentaram. “Em nenhum momento algum membro da equipe de execução percebeu que as linhas de infusão não estavam corretamente colocadas, que as veias haviam rompido e que o pentobarbital estava, no todo ou em parte, entrando no corpo da Sra. Pike”, afirmaram os advogados de Pike em um pedido apresentado ao Tribunal de Chancelaria do 20º Distrito Judicial do Estado do Tennessee. O documento apresenta o quadro mais completo até o momento das consequências médicas de uma tentativa de execução que, segundo o governador do Tennessee, Bill Lee, seguiu o protocolo estabelecido pelo Estado. Foi a segunda execução malsucedida do Estado neste ano. Lee suspendeu todas as outras execuções estaduais até o final de 2026 e ordenou uma investigação independente sobre o ocorrido. Os advogados de Pike afirmaram que as dificuldades da equipe de execução em administrar o medicamento estavam relacionadas ao acesso intravenoso, questão sobre a qual haviam alertado o estado e os tribunais antes da execução. Pike, de 50 anos, foi condenada pelo assassinato de sua colega de classe Colleen Slemmer, de 19 anos, em 1995, quando Pike tinha 18 anos. Ela iria se tornar a primeira mulher executada no Tennessee em mais de dois séculos.

item.title: 北朝鮮が弾道ミサイル、日本ＥＥＺ外に落下 韓国は追加発射を警戒
item.description: ［ソウル／東京 ３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ソウル／東京　３日　ロイター］ - 日韓の防衛当局は３日、北朝鮮が東岸沖へ弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表した。日本の防衛省は、日本の排他的経済水域（ＥＥＺ）外へ落下したと推定している。北朝鮮が弾道ミサイルを発射するのは９月２０日以来。

韓国は国家安全保障会議を招集。同国軍は追加の発射に警戒を強めている。

韓国軍の合同参謀本部によると、北朝鮮は午前６時３０分ごろに東部の元山付近から弾道ミサイルを発射した。日本の防衛省は飛行距離６８０キロ程度、最高高度９０キロ程度と分析。韓国軍は７００キロ以上飛行したと分析している。日本政府は北朝鮮に厳重に抗議した。

韓国と北朝鮮は、非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で発生した地雷の爆発を巡って非難の応酬を続けている。韓国は、北朝鮮の地雷で自国の兵士が重傷を負ったと主張。北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の妹、金与正党総務部長は２日、韓国側の非難を「根拠がない」として一蹴し、韓国側の謝罪要求も退けた。

item.title: Dodgers not talking 3-peat yet as Braves enter NLDS with confidence
item.description: LOS ANGELES -- The potential road to history for the Los Angeles Dodgers begins with a reunion as the National League Division Series starts Saturday afternoon with a visit from the Atlanta Braves.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: LOS ANGELES -- The potential road to history for the Los Angeles Dodgers begins with a reunion as the National League Division Series starts Saturday afternoon with a visit from the Atlanta Braves. Freddie Freeman has been a major postseason contributor during the Dodgers' consecutive World Series titles, and the veteran will be in the heart of the order again in a matchup against his former team. Freeman also was invaluable in the 2021 World Series when the Braves won their most recent title. Freeman joined the Dodgers as a free agent in 2022 after Atlanta moved on to Matt Olson as their first baseman. While Freeman has won three rings in five seasons, the Dodgers are trying to become the first National League club to win championships in three consecutive years. Only two American League franchises have ever done it: the New York Yankees and Oakland Athletics. The Yankees were the last to accomplish the feat when they won championships in 1998, 1999 and 2000. "We don't need to be adding any extra pressure onto ourselves," Dodgers third baseman Max Muncy said. "We've been saying that for a long time. When you talk about three-peating, you're putting that extra pressure on it that doesn't need to be there. Winning a World Series is already hard enough as it is." After returning from a biceps injury during the final week of the regular season, Shohei Ohtani will be back atop the Los Angeles order when the club's postseason run begins. Left-hander Tarik Skubal was named the Dodgers' Game 1 starter over right-hander Yoshinobu Yamamoto. Skubal arrived just before the trade deadline in a deal with the Detroit Tigers and went 5-2 with a 2.61 ERA in 10 starts for his new club. Skubal is 0-1 with a 4.91 ERA in two career starts against Atlanta, including an outing in April when he gave up two runs over seven innings in a no-decision. The Braves opened their postseason by getting past the Philadelphia Phillies in the wild-card round. Atlanta won a winner-take-all Game 3 on Thursday behind a three-run home run from Michael Harris II and a dominating day on the mound. Six pitchers kept Philadelphia in check, including staff ace Chris Sale, who recorded the final four outs. The Braves face the Dodgers after going 5-1 against them in the regular season, including a three-game home sweep in late August. "Everyone knows the Dodgers have a juggernaut, but we played well against them this year," Atlanta manager Walt Weiss said. "I know that doesn't carry a whole lot of stock. Once the playoffs begin, everybody starts at zero. The Dodgers are healthier now than they were when we saw them." Weiss has yet to name his Game 1 starter, with a left-handed opener a possibility to line up against early left-handed bats like Ohtani and Freeman. The Braves will continue to be without a pair of starters in right-hander Bryce Elder (knee) and left-hander Martin Perez (back). Like Freeman before him, Olson has emerged as a Braves leader, along with Ronald Acuna Jr. Olson hit a team-best 41 home runs in the regular season and added another in the wild-card round. Harris hit 26 home runs in the regular season and Acuna added 20 homers and 21 steals. "I think it's just kind of going out there and playing our game and knowing that ... we can compete with them and beat them," said Braves catcher Drake Baldwin, an All-Star and 2025 NL Rookie of the Year who contributed 25 home runs. --Doug Padilla, Field Level Media

item.title: US FDA extends review of Novo Nordisk's hemophilia drug over facility issues
item.description: The US FDA has extended its review of Novo Nordisk's experimental hemophilia A drug due to ongoing remediation work at a manufacturing facility, the Danish drugmaker said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA has extended its review of Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) experimental hemophilia A drug due to ongoing remediation work at a manufacturing facility, the Danish drugmaker said on Friday. Here are some details: The company was seeking the US Food and Drug Administration's approval for denecimig to treat adults and children with hemophilia A, with or without inhibitors, a rare condition that prevents the blood from clotting properly. Novo had submitted the application for denecimig in September 2025 and was expecting an FDA decision in the third quarter of 2026. While the regulator has not yet set a new timeline for its decision, Novo said the FDA did not raise any concerns regarding the safety or effectiveness data from the drug's clinical trials. The company said the manufacturing site issues do not impact any of its other medicines currently on the market. "Novo is already in the process of addressing the FDA's requests as efficiently as possible and continuing to work closely with the agency," CEO Mike Doustdar said in a statement. The company said it still aims to launch denecimig in the US in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approval. The delay would not affect its 2026 financial forecast, Novo said.

item.title: Victoria Beckham apresenta vestidos transparentes e ternos oversized para a primavera/verão 2027
item.description: Victoria Beckham apresentou vestidos de caimento justo, calças amplas e bolsas grandes em seu desfile de primavera/verão 2027 na Semana de Moda de Paris, nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Helen Reid
item.content:encoded: Victoria Beckham apresentou vestidos de caimento justo, calças amplas e bolsas grandes em seu desfile de primavera/verão 2027 na Semana de Moda de Paris, nesta sexta-feira. As modelos usaram ternos oversized em tons de verde e azul, com ombros largos e acolchoados, combinados com calças fluidas que caíam sobre os saltos. Parkas curtas, marcadas na cintura, foram usadas sobre vestidos transparentes com fendas laterais e barras adornadas com pompons. Bolsas gigantes eram carregadas debaixo do braço. O negócio de moda e beleza de Victoria Beckham registrou um lucro operacional de 7,3 milhões de libras (US$9,66 milhões) em 2025, tornando-se lucrativo pela primeira vez desde sua fundação, em 2008. A receita da marca nas áreas de moda, artigos de couro, maquiagem e perfumes cresceu 15%, chegando a 129,8 milhões de libras. A marca possui uma loja principal em Londres e inaugurou sua primeira loja em Nova York no mês passado. Na Conciergerie, uma antiga prisão onde Maria Antonieta ficou detida, as modelos desfilaram diante de fileiras de convidados à luz de velas, incluindo Eva Longoria, David Beckham e os filhos do casal Romeo, Cruz e Harper. O filho mais velho dos Beckhams, Brooklyn, estava ausente. Ele também está na Semana de Moda de Paris, tendo sido visto na primeira fila do desfile da Balenciaga, na quinta-feira, com sua esposa, Nicola Peltz. Brooklyn tornou públicas, em janeiro, acusações sobre o que chamou de comportamento "controlador" de seus pais, revelando pela primeira vez uma disputa familiar. A Semana de Moda de Paris vai até terça-feira, com desfiles de moda feminina de gigantes do setor, como Hermès, Chanel e Louis Vuitton, ainda a acontecer.

item.title: Trump visa policies weigh on Columbia journalism program as admissions pause
item.description: The Trump administration's changing visa policies caused a sharp drop in international applications to Columbia University and contributed to the university pausing admissions to one of its journalism programs, four people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni, Edmund Lee
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration's changing visa policies caused a sharp drop in international applications to Columbia University and contributed to the university pausing admissions to one of its journalism programs, four people familiar with the matter said. The journalism school announced on Thursday it was pausing admissions to its Master of Arts offering to conduct a "critical evaluation," without giving further details about the reasons. Jelani Cobb, the journalism school's dean, said admissions to its Master of Arts program would pause for one year while the school reworked a degree created in 2005, when the "journalism marketplace looked different." "The dynamics of visas and all those other kinds of things were part of the consideration," Cobb told Reuters. Additionally, the department needs time to think through changes to the program, he added. The connection between the admissions pause and US visa policies has not been previously reported, nor has the length of the admissions pause. The drop in international applications shows how uncertainty over President Donald Trump's visa policies is affecting one of the preeminent US journalism institutions, which also administers the profession's highest US honor, the Pulitzer Prize. The people did not disclose the exact size of the drop in applications. Last year, the Trump administration temporarily halted new student-visa appointments, then resumed them with [USN:S0N3OK04N TEXT:"expanded screening"] of applicants' online activity, saying the checks were needed to identify potential threats to US national security. Columbia was among the universities targeted by his administration over pro-Palestinian campus protests in 2024. Last year, it agreed to [USN:FWN3TK1JE TEXT:"pay over $200 million"] to settle federal investigations and regain most of its suspended federal funding. A new rule this year also sought to limit how long foreign students and journalists could stay in the US without seeking extensions, but a [USN:L1N4560X0 TEXT:"federal judge blocked it"] before it took effect last month, calling its rationale "exceptionally weak." RELIANCE ON INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS Visa difficulties and immigration policy uncertainty have deterred prospective Columbia journalism students from abroad, the four people said, requesting anonymity to discuss its admissions. International students make up roughly half of the M.A. program's enrollment, the people said. Kaushik Raj, an Indian journalist admitted to Columbia's separate M.S. program in data journalism, was denied a US student visa last year, the Intercept reported . His rejection letter said he had not shown sufficient ties to India to establish he would return after his studies, according to the report. Geared toward mid-career journalists seeking expertise in subjects such as politics, business and science, the M.A. program is smaller than the Master of Science program aimed at students with less journalism experience. The school is not pausing the MS program. Lower enrollment has prompted changes to the M.A. program, including the combination of science and politics seminars in the 2024-25 academic year, two of the people familiar with the matter said. On Thursday, the school also announced a two-year, part-time online M.S. program. The move could allow Columbia to enroll international students without visas, but Cobb said it was unrelated to the M.A. admissions pause because the programs serve different students. CHANGING DYNAMICS OF JOURNALISM The M.A. pause comes as news organizations grapple with AI's potential to reshape how stories are produced and found, while falling search traffic piles pressure on their business. Last year, at least 3,434 journalism jobs were cut in the UK and US, according to a Press Gazette tracker . The BBC and CBS News have announced layoffs this year. Some journalists took to social media on Thursday to criticize the M.A. program as too short and too expensive. The course spans nine months and Columbia estimates the cost of attendance at $120,000 before financial aid. The year-long M.S. in Data Journalism costs about $180,000. Two of the people familiar with the matter said the financial assistance made tuition less of a deterrent because most students receive financial aid. About 80% of the students receive financial aid, including grants, loans, or scholarships from institutional, federal and private funds, according to its website. Cobb said the journalism school wants to create a new fundraising strategy for the M.A. program and is considering starting a part-time version.

item.title: 原油先物反落、Ｇ７が石油備蓄1億バレル協調放出で合意
item.description:

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物反落、Ｇ７が石油備蓄1億バレル協調放出で合意 6:28 配信

英ロンドンのガソリンスタンドで２日撮影。REUTERS/Toby Melville

Erwin Seba

[ヒューストン　２日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は反落して取引を終えた。欧州首脳が、価格引き下げに向けてディーゼル燃料（軽油）の備蓄を放出するよう求めていた米国の要請に応じることで合意した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．０６ドル（０．０６％）安の１バレル＝１０２．２５ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．７６ドル（１．９０％）安の１バレル＝９１．１１ドル。

主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）を通じてディーゼル燃料などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。Ｇ７の発表に先立ち、トランプ米大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と表明していた。

プライス・フューチャーズ・グループのシニアアナリスト、フィル・フリン氏は「欧州はかなり脆弱だと感じている」とし、「（米国が）ディーゼルの輸出禁止を発動すれば、欧州は最も打撃を受ける地域の１つとなるだろう」と述べた。

item.title: 米国株式市場＝続伸、雇用統計受け利上げ観測後退 小型株高い
item.description:
Chuck Mikolajczak
[ニューヨーク ２日 ロイター] - 米国株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。この日発...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝続伸、雇用統計受け利上げ観測後退　小型株高い 6:26 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）前で２０２１年７月撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

Chuck Mikolajczak

[ニューヨーク　２日　ロイター] - 米国株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。この日発表された雇用統計の内容を受け、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による今月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測が後退した。

米労働省労働統計局が発表した９月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。過去２カ月分も大幅に下方改定された。失業率は４．２％で、前月の４．１％から上昇した。

これを受け、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが１０月のＦＯＭＣで少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）利上げするとの観測は２２．７％と、前日の２４．４％、１週間前の６４．２％から低下した。

ニューヨークのサミットＴＸキャピタルのトレーディング責任者ロバート・バーンストン氏は「本日の統計は、景気が急速に過熱していないという意味では悪くない」と指摘。その上で、「しかし、短期的な利上げ観測を後退させる点では良いが、景気やインフレを巡る懸念もあるため、市場は慎重ながらも楽観的な姿勢を取っている」と述べた。

利上げ観測の後退を受け、金利に敏感な銘柄が買われた。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の不動産セクターは０．４％高、中小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は０．９％高と、１日としては過去１カ月で最大の上昇率となった。

大型株も相場をけん引し、エヌビディアは１．３％高、 テスラは４．７％高と、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種を大きく押し上げた。テスラの上昇を受けＳ＆Ｐの一般消費財セクターは１．４％ 高と、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち最も高いパフォーマンスとなった。

スポーツ用品大手ナイキは３．６％安。同社は１日、２０２７会計年度売上高が１桁台後半の減少率になるとの見通しを示したほか、追加の人員削減や世界事業の再編を含む新たな経営改善策を発表した。

データ記憶装置メーカーの株価も下落。ウエスタン・デジタルとシーゲイト・テクノロジーはいずれも約１０％急落し、Ｓ＆Ｐの情報技術セクターで下落率トップとなった。東芝が２０２７年度中に人工知能（ＡＩ）データセンター向けのハードディスクドライブ（ＨＤＤ）の生産能力を倍増すると日経新聞が報じたことが材料となった。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．６７対１の比率で上回ったほか、ナスダックでも１．３４対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１６９億３０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億８０００万株。

item.title: Petrobras encuentra más petróleo frente a las costas del estado brasileño de Amapá
item.description: La petrolera estatal brasileña Petrobras anunció el viernes que encontro petróleo en aguas ultraprofundas frente a las costas del estado de Amapá, en una región conocida como "Margen Ecuatorial", la que considera su nueva frontera petrolera más prometedora.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La petrolera estatal brasileña Petrobras (PETR3.SA) anunció el viernes que encontro petróleo en aguas ultraprofundas frente a las costas del estado de Amapá, en una región conocida como "Margen Ecuatorial", la que considera su nueva frontera petrolera más prometedora. Según un informe presentado ante la autoridad bursátil, halló un intervalo petrolífero en el pozo Morpho, lo que supone un nuevo descubrimiento en el bloque FZA-M-59, donde ya se habían identificado hidrocarburos en agosto. El descubrimiento se realizó en un segundo yacimiento, situado a mayor profundidad en el mismo pozo del hallazgo de agosto, según la empresa. Se prevé que los trabajos en el pozo concluyan a finales de octubre, dijo el viernes a los periodistas la presidenta ejecutiva, Magda Chambriard. Petrobras perforará tres nuevos pozos en la zona para determinar si es viable la producción comercial en la cuenca de Foz do Amazonas, una zona sensible desde el punto de vista medioambiental. Foz do Amazonas comparte similitudes geológicas con las costas de Guyana, donde ExxonMobil (XOM.N) está desarrollando enormes yacimientos.

item.title: 米司法省、パウエル前ＦＲＢ議長の捜査再開せず 改修費問題で
item.description: [２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２日 ロイター] - 米司法省は２日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）本部改修工事の費用超過を巡るパウエル前ＦＲＢ議長への刑事捜査を再開しないと明らかにした。同省報道官が述べた。

ただ、ブランチ米司法長官は、最初にこの動きを報じたブルームバーグ・ニュースに対し、改修工事の監督状況について調査を続け、不正の証拠が明らかになれば措置を講じる可能性を排除していないと語った。

ＦＲＢ報道官からは、ブランチ氏の発言について直ちにコメントは得られなかった。

ＦＲＢの監察機関は３０日、首都ワシントンにあるＦＲＢ本部２棟の改修工事で約１０億ドルの費用超過が生じた問題について、連邦刑法違反を疑う合理的な根拠や職務上の不正は確認されなかったとする報告書を公表した。

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル、対ユーロで4週連続高へ 雇用統計受け上昇一服
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが対ユーロで４週連続で上昇する見通し。ユーロ圏債の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル、対ユーロで4週連続高へ　雇用統計受け上昇一服 6:16 配信

2025年5月4日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

［ニューヨーク　２日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが対ユーロで４週連続で上昇する見通し。ユーロ圏債の売りを背景に米債利回りが上昇しているほか、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が引き続きタカ派的な金融政策スタンスを維持するとの期待がドルを支援している。

ただ、２日発表された米雇用統計を受け、ドルは最近の上昇分を一部削った。９月の雇用統計では、非農業部門雇用者数が２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。失業率は４．２％で、前月の４．１％から上昇した。

ノムラのＧ１０為替戦略責任者ドミニク・バニング氏は、雇用統計が全体として「ゴルディロックス（適温）」状態を示唆したと指摘。「経済活動は引き続きかなり堅調だが、大きなインフレ圧力を生み出していない」と述べた。その上で、市場が織り込む米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ見通しを大きく変える可能性は低いとしつつも、「１０月の追加利上げを巡るテールリスクを幾分後退させる効果はあるだろう」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場はＦＲＢが８６％の確率で１０月に金利を据え置くと見込んでいる。１週間前は３６％だった。

終盤の取引で、ユーロ／ドルは０．１３％高の１．１２５８０ドル。ただ、ユーロは週間では４週連続での下げとなる見通しで、これは２０２５年５月半ば以来最長となる。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１％安の１０１．８８。ただ、週足では３週連続で上昇する見込み。

ドル／円は０．１５％安の１５７．８１円。ただ、ドルは週間で３週連続の上昇となる見通し。

ドル／スイスフランも０．３％安の０．８２８５フラン。

また、ユーロ圏金融・債券市場では、財政問題の悪化とインフレ高進を巡る懸念から、仏１０年債利回りが約２５年ぶりに５％近辺まで上昇する場面があった。

ユーロは対スイスフランで０．１５％安の０．９３２７フラン、対円では横ばいの１７７．６７円となった。週間ベースでは、ユーロはスイスフラン、円双方に対し下落する見通し。
